newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria Elitbank to raise capital to 36 bln levs.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria Elitbank to raise capital to 36 bln levs.

text.p: Bulgaria's private Elitbank, in recievership since September, decided to raise capital nine-fold to 36 billion levs in a bid to avoid an insolvency ruling by the court, a bank official said on Friday.

"The bank shareholders approved a rise in share capital to 36 billion levs from four billion levs now through a new share issue to be offered to new investors," the official who declined to be named told Reuters.
The new share issue was expected to attract fresh investment to help the bank to cover its liabilities and boost its capital base in order to avoid bankruptcy, the official added.

The central bank put Elitbank in receivership on September 23 due to a danger of insolvency, dismissed its board and appointed sequestrators, citing a capital-to-risks assets ratio of minus 2.42 percent and overdue payments of 261 million levs.
An insolvency suit against Elitbank was filed by the central bank four months later and a court ruling on the case is expected on June 26.
The official said that 50 percent or 16 billion levs of projected capital rise would be covered by voting shares.

The shareholders also decided that Elitbank sequestators are to call an extraordinary meeting on June 23 to elect new members of the board of directors in line with expected changes in the bank's ownership, the official said.
